error.inUse: This record is still used by other records and cannot be deleted.

help.code: Letters, digits, _ . - ; stored in capitals; unique.
help.transfer: A hand-over position between pieces of equipment.
help.capacityHu: How many handling units fit on one location of this type.
help.container: Other handling units can be placed in or on this type.
help.levelNo: Floor or storage level; locations are drawn per level in the layout view.
help.position: Position in millimetres, used by the layout view.
help.enabled: A disabled location is switched off completely.
help.blockedIn: Nothing may be put into this location.
help.blockedOut: Nothing may be taken out of this location.
help.blockReason: Required when the location is blocked.
help.externalRef: Address of this location in the PLC or host system.
help.extAttributes: Project-specific extra fields as JSON text, e.g. {"zone":"cold"}.
help.huTypeEmpty: Leave empty if the link is valid for all handling-unit types.
help.linkEquipment: The equipment that performs the move (optional).
help.cost: Routing cost; routes with the lowest total cost are preferred.
help.parentEquipment: Optional: the equipment this one belongs to, e.g. a conveyor line that contains transfer units.
help.plcConnection: Connection details for the PLC (used in a later phase).
help.equipmentEnabled: A disabled piece of equipment is not used for transport.

bulk.tooMany: At most {{max}} rows can be changed at once.
bulk.reasonText: This will be applied to {{count}} selected location(s). Enter the reason; it is saved with each location.

equipmentTypes.title: Equipment types
equipmentTypes.builtInHint: Built-in types are fixed and cannot be changed or deleted.
equipmentTypes.helpSuper: Built-in types are fixed. You can add your own types and change or delete them.
equipmentTypes.helpOthers: The list of equipment types is shared by all projects. Only a super administrator can add types.

assign.huTypesHelp: Tick the handling-unit types that may be placed on locations of this location type.
assign.locationsHelp: Add locations one by one, or add all locations of an area and/or matching a text at once. Nothing is saved until you press Save.
assign.tooManyMatches: {{count}} locations match - narrow the search (at most {{max}} at once).
assign.placedInHelp: Tick the handling-unit types that {{code}} may be placed in or on (for example a carton on a pallet). Optionally limit the quantity per carrier.
assign.badQty: The maximum quantity must be a whole number of at least 1, or empty for no limit.

import.title: Import from spreadsheet
import.intro: Load master data from a CSV or Excel file. Nothing is changed until you have checked the file and pressed Apply.
import.stepChoose: Choose table and get the template
import.step1: 1. Choose the table and download the template
import.step2: 2. Upload the file and check it
import.orderHint: Load the tables in the order of this list (areas first, assignments last): a row can only refer to records that already exist. A row whose code already exists updates that record; a column left out of the file keeps its stored value.
import.noFile: No file chosen (.csv or .xlsx, up to 10 MB)
import.nothingToDo: The file is correct but contains nothing new: all rows are already in the system as they are.
import.readyToApply: The file is correct. Nothing has been changed yet - press Apply in step 3 to save it.
import.fixFirst: Correct the rows with errors in the file and check it again. Apply is only possible when there are no errors.
import.truncated: Only the first {{count}} rows are listed (all errors are always shown).
import.applyHelp: All rows are saved together. If anything goes wrong, nothing is saved.
import.confirmText: {{table}}: {{created}} new, {{updated}} updated, {{added}} added. All rows are saved together or not at all, and every change is written to the audit log.
import.applied: Import applied: {{created}} new, {{updated}} updated, {{added}} added, {{unchanged}} unchanged.
import.refused: The import was refused and nothing was saved. See the rows with errors below.

validation.title: Check configuration
validation.intro: Looks for the mistakes that most often break a go-live: links to nowhere, storage that nothing can reach, equipment without locations, and more. This only reads - nothing is changed.
validation.summary: {{errors}} rule(s) with errors, {{warnings}} with warnings, {{passed}} passed.
validation.checked: Checked {{locations}} locations, {{links}} links and {{equipment}} pieces of equipment in {{ms}} ms.

notFound.body: The page you are looking for does not exist.

users.title: Users
users.search: Search name, user name or e-mail
users.usernameFixed: The user name cannot be changed.
users.passwordInfo: A temporary password is generated when you create the user. You will see it once; the user must change it at the first sign-in.
users.superOnly: Only a super administrator can change this account.
users.ownRolesFixed: You cannot change your own roles.
users.ownAccountFixed: You cannot disable your own account.
users.ownPassword: To change your own password use "Change password" in the user menu.
users.enabledHelp: A disabled user cannot sign in, and is signed out at once.
users.resetText: A new temporary password will be created for {{name}}. The old password stops working and {{name}} is signed out. The user must choose a new password at the next sign-in.
users.tempWarning: Write it down or copy it now - it is shown only once and cannot be looked up later. Give it to the user in person or by phone, not by e-mail. If it is lost, reset the password again.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every sign-in, user change and master-data change is recorded here and cannot be edited. Click a row to see the values before and after.
